elements.element: Audit frequency limited to no more than once per 12 months
elements.evidence: "no more than once in any 12 months"

elements.element: Audit performed by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality
elements.evidence: "by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality"

elements.element: Vendor bears audit cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%
elements.evidence: "at Vendor's cost unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding 5% for the audited period"; 22.2 "Vendor bears audit costs unless ... exceeding five percent"

elements.element: No direct access to Customer systems
elements.evidence: "may not remotely access Customer's systems and records"; 22.2 "may not access Customer systems directly"
"no more than once in any 12 months"

elements.element: Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%
elements.evidence: "underpayment exceeding 5% for the audited period" (threshold is 5%, not 10%)

offending_extra_words: and at Vendor's cost unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding 5% for the audited period
reasons: All six atomic preferred elements are satisfied: once per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, business hours, independent confidentiality-bound auditor, Vendor cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct/remote system access (reinforced by the untouched 22.2 carve-out).

Minimality fails on two counts: 'off-site where possible' is a new restriction not required by the preferred position, and the cost-allocation clause in the inserted sentence duplicates the identical protection already present in 22.2 (Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent).

Intent is preserved: 22.2's access carve-outs and shortfall payment mechanic remain effective, no undefined terms are introduced, and the duplicated cost language is redundant rather than contradictory (both use the same 5% trigger).
Fallback is not independently satisfied because its 10% underpayment threshold is not present; this is immaterial since the locked preferred level is met.
Suggested tightening: drop 'off-site where possible' and end the inserted sentence after 'independent auditor bound by confidentiality', relying on 22.2 for cost allocation.
